item.title: Gen. Jerome F. O’Malley AL Post donates to Carbondale Area’s Polar Bear Plunge team
item.description: Members of the Gen. Jerome F. O’Malley Post of the American Legion recently made a donation to Carbondale Area Junior/Senior High School's Polar Bear Plunge team in support of the Special Olympics of Northeast Pennsylvania.

item.title: Johnson College receives $5,000 contribution from Fidelity Bank
item.description: Johnson College recently received a $5,000 contribution from Fidelity Bank to support students enrolled in the college’s Industry Fast Track program.

item.title: The Wright Medicine: National Wear Red Day drives home importance of women’s heart health
item.description: You might be surprised to learn that cardiovascular disease is the No. 1 killer of women in the United States. That’s why awareness matters — and why initiatives like the American Heart Association’s National Wear Red Day play such an important role. This year’s observance takes place on Friday, Feb. 6.

item.title: Committed to service on Martin Luther King Jr. Day
item.description: Representatives of St. Joseph’s Center found Martin Luther King Jr. Day to be the perfect opportunity for collecting new and gently used winter clothing for children, embracing the late civil rights leader’s commitment to service.

item.title: Olyphant police, volunteers hold winter coat giveaway
item.description: For the fifth year, the Olyphant Police Department held a coat giveaway, organized by police Sgt. Lewis Kline. The department worked with the Dickson City Civic Center and the Throop Civic Center to identify those in need of winter coats. Olyphant Hose Company 2 and Ladder 26 assisted in packing the gifts and delivering them.

item.title: A wondrous return: Wonderstone Gallery reopens in Bucktown Center
item.description: A local business offering yoga classes and self-care items has found a new home. The Wonderstone Gallery has reopened in the Bucktown Center, 222 E. Drinker St., Dunmore. Owner Beth Ann Zero and her daughter, Melissa Martini, opened the Wonderstone Gallery in November 2013 at its previous location on North Blakely Street in Dunmore, according to Zero.
